quotes.text: now they are making music the way they want to make music
quotes.publication: Review: Orchestral Manoeuvres In The Dark – English Electric

quotes.text: we were assigned to do a one off event and we really wanted to come up with the most preposterous name they could ever think of – Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark – having absolutely know meaning whatsoever
This was a record by Paul and I!
then yes let us call it retro
We spoke with our own authentic sound
there are too many bands of our generation that do not have anything more to say

In those days we used a tape machine as our DAW, we recorded on tape and then literally cut and pasted the tapes, so I would sit by the tape machine and Paul by the keyboard, now I sit by the Mac and Paul still by his keyboard
I am huge fan of EchoFarm, switching it on and instantly everything sounds like the old days.
Back then everything centered around classic analog Korgs, Rolands but now we are purely software based
The first synth we acquired, via a mail order service and cost us 7GBP for 36 weeks in a row, was the Korg Micro Preset
